rules.statement: A written convention is needed and must be declared or authorised before any benefit

basis.citation: Code de la santé publique L.1453-3 ff. as reformed by Ordonnance 2017-49; Décret 2020-730 of 15 June 2020; in force 1 October 2020.

rules.statement: Route: declaration or prior authorisation, by amount

basis.citation: Arrêté du 7 août 2020 fixant les montants à partir desquels une convention prévue à l'article L. 1453-8 est soumise à autorisation (JORFTEXT000042234024).
basis.verificationNote: Primary source not readable in the 27 Oct 2026 authoring session: WebFetch failed DNS resolution for the host and curl through the egress proxy received 403 on CONNECT (hosts tried: cms.gov, ecfr.gov, law.cornell.edu, govinfo.gov, federalregister.gov, irs.gov, accme.org, pmcpa.org.uk, legifrance.gouv.fr, eur-lex.europa.eu). Thresholds by category could not be reconciled: €1,000 (donation to an association, per Vigier and ONPP), €5,000 (research donation per convention), €10,000 (association reconnue d'utilité publique), and an €8,000 figure whose category was truncated. Whether the threshold is 'at or above' or 'above' also conflicts between sources. Severity is judge until a person reads the arrêté.

rules.statement: The convention and any benefit of €10 or more are published on Transparence Santé

parameters.label: Authorisation threshold: donation to an association (whole convention)
parameters.source: UNVERIFIED. Candidates in sources: €1,000 for association donations (Vigier Avocats; ONPP), €5,000 for research donations per convention (Légifrance summary; Tours note), €10,000 where the beneficiary is an association reconnue d'utilité publique, and an €8,000 figure with truncated category (Tours note). €1,000 is used as the most cautious value: it sends more requests to a person.

clauses.label: Objet de la convention
clauses.text: La présente convention a pour objet [objet], au bénéfice de [bénéficiaire], pour un montant total de [montant] € sur toute sa durée.

clauses.label: Déclaration ou autorisation préalable
clauses.text: La convention est soumise, selon son montant, à déclaration ou à autorisation préalable auprès de l'instance ordinale ou de l'ARS compétente. Aucun avantage n'est accordé avant l'expiration du délai applicable.

clauses.label: Transparence
clauses.text: Le bénéficiaire est informé que l'existence de la convention et les avantages consentis font l'objet d'une publication sur la base Transparence Santé.

notes: legifrance.gouv.fr was blocked, and web searches on 27 Oct 2026 did not surface the arrêté thresholds. A search did confirm (secondary: DS Avocats, CMS France) that the arrêté of 7 August 2020 sets per-category thresholds above which authorisation is required and that filing is by téléprocédure.

Because the threshold value is unverified, FR-AC-02 and FR-AC-04 are severity judge: a person decides the route. FR-AC-03 (record number before payment) is block because the obligation itself is not in doubt.
Which French recipients fall within L.1453-4 (associations of health professionals, health establishments, foundations) is decided by Compliance; v1 scopes the pack to every French request.
